name: ASM-019 compact pan-tilt servo head assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a small pan-tilt camera head with base servo, turntable, tilt yoke, camera body, cable loop, and repeated fasteners.

tasks.prompt: Create a compact pan-tilt servo camera head assembly with a rectangular base, pan servo, round turntable, paired tilt yoke arms, tilt servo, camera block with lens, pivot pins, cable loop, and repeated mounting screws. Use robust primitive geometry and maintain a readable mechatronics silhouette.
assumptions: Intermediate assembly benchmark targets a readable robotic pan-tilt head rather than a generic stack of boxes.
Repeated components are functional: yoke sides, pivot pins, servo cases, and screws.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
